6.232 rsWrongNumberOfTablixCornerCells
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsWrongNumberOfTablixCornerCells is a critical error that will occur when the number of
TablixCornerCell elements within a TablixCornerRow is different than the number of distinct header
columns created by the TablixMember.TablixHeader elements in the Tablix.TablixRowHierarchy.
